newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strategie Grains raises EU grain crop forecast.
newsitem.headline: Strategie Grains raises EU grain crop forecast.

text.p: French grain analyst Strategie Grains said on Monday it had revised up its forecast for 1996 European Union grain output to 203.5 million tonnes from last month's target of 202.2 million.
This would represent a jump of more than 15 percent from the 176.7 million tonnes of grain produced in 1995.
In its December report Strategie Grains said it had revised up its estimates for barley, soft wheat and maize output in 1996.
Wheat output was put at 90.5 million tonnes against a previous target of 90.2 million and 80.1 million in 1995.
Strategie Grains said the upward revision in wheat output was mostly linked to a higher than expected crop in Denmark.
The analyst now targets a Danish soft wheat crop of 4.67 million tonnes against 4.40 million forecast last month and 4.60 million produced in 1995.
Strategie Grains raises its estimate for European Union barley production to 52.5 million tonnes from a November target of 52.1 million and a 1995 output of 43.7 million.
It also increased its forecast for the 1996 maize crop to 34.1 million tonnes from a previous target of 33.4 million and 29.6 million produced in 1995.
Strategie Grains linked the higher maize forecast to a stronger than expected harvest in France.
It now targets a 1996 French maize crop of 14.22 million tonnes against 13.59 million forecast last month and 12.74 million produced in 1995.
